name: padBits
meaning: PS1-layout active-low pad word built by InputMgr_Poll (0x1000 Triangle ... 0x0001 Select)

name: menuNav
meaning: arrow-key nav word with auto-repeat (0xffef up, 0xffbf down, 0xffdf right, 0xff7f left; 0xffff none)

name: pausePressed
meaning: Pause or P pressed this frame (edge)

name: device3
meaning: the mouse device: ctor 0x409e90 (vtable 0x574334, deviceKind 4). InputMgr passes 12 buttons (push 0xc at 0x527c97) but the ctor caps the count at 4 (cmp ecx,4 / jle at 0x409eac).

name: preferred
meaning: device to return to when it responds again

name: padTable
meaning: 16 x {InputDevice *dev; u16 code; u16 pad} for the pad

name: lastNav
meaning: previous nav value for the auto-repeat (u16: InputMgr_Poll compares it with movzx at 0x528a96)
